title: Correction: Neonatal blood lead concentration predicts medium term lead-related outcomes in children ≤5 years old with congenital lead poisoning: A retrospective cohort study in Northern Nigeria.
ehr_evidence: The text is a correction statement regarding funding and competing interests for a previously published retrospective cohort study; it does not contain original data analysis or specify an electronic health record system.
summary: This manuscript is a correction notice for a retrospective cohort study on neonatal blood lead concentration and medium-term outcomes in children with congenital lead poisoning in Northern Nigeria, correcting funding and conflict of interest statements.
study_design: retrospective cohort study (as described in the referenced original article)
population: children ≤5 years old with congenital lead poisoning in Northern Nigeria (as described in the referenced original article)
limitations: None explicitly stated in this correction notice.
data_availability_statement: This does not alter our adherence to PLOS Global Public Health policies on sharing data and materials.
